description: This Java class implements the <property-to-field> element for the MiniLang language in the Apache OFBiz framework, handling property retrieval and mapping to fields with support for localization, default values, and argument formatting.

classes.name: PropertyToField
classes.description: Handles the <property-to-field> element, retrieving property values and assigning them to a specified field, with support for localization, default fallback, argument formatting, and deprecation correction.

classes.name: PropertyToFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of PropertyToField from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Corrects deprecated attribute 'arg-list-name' to 'arg-list' during XML parsing.

methods.name: PropertyToField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes, with validation and auto-correction.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the property retrieval and mapping logic, supporting localization, default values, and argument substitution.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, mainly for debugging.
